name: OCP Cardinal
description: Built-in Cardinal red-flag indicators (OCDS path requirements)

indicators.name: Short submission period
indicators.description: Submission window (endDate − startDate) shorter than threshold. Flags inadequate notice to bidders.
indicators.tracks: Whether bidders had adequate calendar time between notice and bid deadline.

steps: Parse tender/tenderPeriod/startDate and endDate.
Compute inclusive or calendar-day difference.
Compare to default threshold (often 15 days) or per procurementMethodDetails override.
Typically filtered to open, selective, or limited competitive methods.
computation.thresholds_note: Configure per method in cardinal_settings.ini — e.g. Public Bidding 15 days, Shopping 7 days.

indicators.interpretation: A hit suggests rushed procurement or compressed notice that may limit fair competition.
indicators.limitations: Cancelled tenders should be excluded. Missing endDate prevents computation (~2% on PhilGEPS CSV).

indicators.name: Single bid received
indicators.description: Competitive procedure (open/selective) with only one tenderer. Distinct from missing bidder data.
indicators.tracks: Competitive procedure with exactly one disclosed tenderer.

steps: Filter to competitive procurement methods.
Count distinct bids/details/tenderers (by id or name).
Flag when exactly one tenderer is recorded.
Do not fire when bids block is absent — that is a separate transparency issue.

indicators.interpretation: May indicate weak competition, restrictive specs, or collusion — warrants review, not proof of fraud.
indicators.limitations: Requires bidder disclosure. Absent bids ≠ single bid (see PH-C02). PhilGEPS CSV ~46% bidder fill.

indicators.name: Price close to winning bid
indicators.description: Winning bid price suspiciously close to second-lowest valid bid (collusion signal).
indicators.tracks: Suspicious proximity between winning and runner-up bid prices.

steps: Collect valid bids with value/amount and tenderer id.
Identify winning supplier from awards/suppliers.
Find second-lowest valid bid from a different tenderer.
Flag when relative price gap is below configured threshold (collusion proxy).
computation.thresholds_note: Default relative threshold is set in Cardinal config; requires ≥2 comparable valid bids.

indicators.interpretation: Classic bid-rigging signal — coordinated pricing just above the winner.
indicators.limitations: Not feasible on PhilGEPS flat CSV (no bid amounts). Requires normalized bid tables.

indicators.name: Excessive unsuccessful bids
indicators.description: Top tenderer wins unusually few of their submitted bids across processes.
indicators.tracks: Tenderer win rate across many processes — unusually low for active bidders.

computation.summary: wins / bids_submitted < threshold for tenderers with high bid volume
steps: Aggregate bids and awards by tenderer id across the dataset.
Compute win rate for tenderers above minimum bid count.
Flag tenderers whose win rate is statistically low (cover bidding proxy).
computation.thresholds_note: Buyer/tenderer scope — requires stable tenderer ids across OCIDs.

indicators.interpretation: May indicate cover bidding — submitting losing bids to create false competition.
indicators.limitations: Multi-release history required; not a per-OCID flag. Needs bid status and award linkage.

indicators.name: Identical bid prices
indicators.description: Different tenderers submitted bids with the same price.
indicators.tracks: Exact or near-identical bid amounts from distinct tenderers on one process.

computation.summary: ∃ pair of valid bids from different tenderers with equal value/amount
steps: List valid bids with amount and tenderer id.
Compare amounts across distinct tenderers.
Flag when two or more tenderers share the same price.

indicators.interpretation: Possible collusion, shared pricing, or copy-paste error.
indicators.limitations: Requires bid amounts — blocked on PhilGEPS flat CSV.

indicators.name: Late bid won
indicators.description: Winning bid received after the submission deadline.
indicators.tracks: Whether the winning bid was submitted after tender/tenderPeriod/endDate.

steps: Identify winning tenderer from awards/suppliers.
Find matching bid detail date for that tenderer.
Compare bid submission timestamp to closing datetime.

indicators.interpretation: Procedural irregularity — late bids should not win under standard rules.
indicators.limitations: Requires per-bid submission timestamps; not in PhilGEPS flat CSV.

indicators.name: All except winning bid disqualified
indicators.description: Only the winner's bids are valid; all other tenderers disqualified.
indicators.tracks: Single valid bidder after disqualifying all competitors.

computation.summary: count(valid bids) = 1 AND count(disqualified bids) ≥ 1 from other tenderers
steps: Classify bids/details/status as valid vs disqualified.
Identify award winner.
Flag when only the winner's bid remains valid and others were disqualified.

indicators.interpretation: May indicate selective disqualification to steer award to preferred bidder.
indicators.limitations: Requires per-bid evaluation status from bid tables.

indicators.name: Lowest bid disqualified
indicators.description: Lowest priced bid disqualified while a higher bid wins (price-only award).
indicators.tracks: Lowest valid price disqualified; higher-priced bid awarded.

computation.summary: min(valid bid amounts) disqualified AND award to higher amount
steps: Rank valid bids by value/amount.
Check status of lowest bid.
Verify award went to a higher-priced tenderer on price-only criteria.

indicators.interpretation: Possible biased evaluation or unjustified rejection of lowest bidder.
indicators.limitations: Requires bid amounts and status; price-only award context.

indicators.name: Excessive disqualified bids
indicators.description: Buyer, procuring entity, or tenderer disqualifies bids at unusually high rate.
indicators.tracks: Aggregate disqualification rate per buyer or procuring entity across processes.

computation.summary: disqualified_bids / total_bids > threshold for buyer/id (or procuringEntity)
steps: Aggregate bid counts and disqualifications by buyer or procuring entity.
Compute disqualification rate over a minimum sample of bids.
Flag entities with statistically high disqualification rates.
computation.thresholds_note: Buyer-level indicator — needs many processes per entity.

indicators.interpretation: Systematic harsh evaluation or barriers to entry for certain buyers.
indicators.limitations: Multi-process aggregation; requires stable buyer/id and bid status.

indicators.name: Heterogeneous supplier
indicators.description: Supplier wins across unusually many UNSPSC product categories.
indicators.tracks: Supplier winning contracts in an unusually diverse range of product categories.

computation.summary: count(distinct classification/id per supplier) > threshold across awards
steps: Collect awards for each supplier id.
Extract items/classification/id (UNSPSC) per award.
Count distinct categories per supplier over minimum award volume.
Flag suppliers exceeding category diversity threshold.
computation.thresholds_note: Tenderer-scope — run after prepare with item_classification_scheme = UNSPSC.

indicators.interpretation: May indicate shell companies, conflict of interest, or unrealistic supplier capability.
indicators.limitations: ~48% UNSPSC fill on PhilGEPS CSV; best for suppliers with many awards.

indicators.name: Heavily discounted bid
indicators.description: Winning bid far below second-lowest valid bid (lemons / unrealistic pricing).
indicators.tracks: Winning bid price suspiciously lower than the next valid bid.

steps: Collect valid bid amounts and identify winner.
Find second-lowest valid bid from another tenderer.
Flag when relative discount exceeds threshold (unrealistic pricing / lemons problem).
computation.thresholds_note: Mirror of R024 with large gap threshold — config in Cardinal settings.

indicators.interpretation: May indicate dump pricing, capability risk, or bid manipulation.
indicators.limitations: Requires bid amounts — not feasible on PhilGEPS flat CSV.
